enonce_intro_markdown:
A bag contains 6 black pens and 4 red pens. Given that a pen is chosen at random from the bag.

Find the probability that:

questions.corrige_markdown:
The bag holds $6+4=10$ pens, of which $4$ are red.

$P(\text{red})=\dfrac{4}{10}=\dfrac25$.

**Answer: $\dfrac25$** (that is $0.4$).

questions.enonce_markdown: b) the pen is either red or black. *[5 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Every pen in the bag is either red or black, so all $10$ pens qualify:

$P(\text{red or black})=\dfrac{4+6}{10}=\dfrac{10}{10}=1$.

Check: $P(\text{red})+P(\text{black})=\dfrac25+\dfrac35=1$. This is a certain event.

**Answer: $1$.**
